prompt: Watch aligned starts and order strips.

prompt: Watch hand spans, steps and a local choice.

answer: Observed method and actual count, with unit/person and any leftover part; do not invent a value.

prompt: Together order three safe similar pencils. Measure one. Which would cover your short paper label? Check it against the label.

prompt: Align starts. Say the shortest and longest. Say the order from shortest to longest. Explain how the ends help.

prompt: Align starts. Say the shortest and longest. Say the order from shortest to longest. Explain how the ends help.

prompt: Work alone. Order three safe similar objects nearby. Measure one with your repeated strip unit. Measure a reachable table in your hand spans and a clear safe path in your steps. Record whose units, full counts and any part. An adult supervises safety without giving answers.
answer: Actual aligned local order; no gaps/overlaps; named person, unit, full count and leftover part for each measure. Record any seated strip adaptation separately; absent natural-unit action is not assessed.
